prompt:

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a one-piece swimsuit worn with flowing wide-leg beach trousers in light silk — in bold navy-and-white stripes; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm reaches up, the hand on the shelf or line above her head — her near arm, on the camera side; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
